paper_title: MMAR A Challenging Benchmark for Deep Reasoning in Speech, Audio,   Music, and Their Mix
caption: : Compare with noise input on MMAR
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy of different models across three categories, comparing audio input to noise input. The horizontal axis displays the categories: "Qwen2-Audio-Instruct," "Audio-Reasoner," and "Qwen-2.5-Omni," presented in that order from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled "Accuracy (%)", uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, with tick labels incrementing by 10. Three bars are present for each category, representing different conditions, colored blue for the audio input and purple for the noise input. The "Qwen2-Audio-Instruct" bar representing audio input has an approximate value of 28%, while the corresponding noise bar has an approximate value of 37%. The "Audio-Reasoner" category shows an audio bar with a value of approximately 36% and a noise bar with a value of approximately 33%. Finally, in "Qwen-2.5-Omni," the audio bar is approximately 54% tall, with the noise bar at approximately 26%. A dashed horizontal line is present at the 30% mark. The bars are not visually emphasized beyond their colors, and are sorted by category.
